reason: A testing-focused skill that derives prioritized functional test cases from requirements or change descriptions and outputs an Excel-style test report.

summaries.zh: 根据产品需求、Git 提交信息或用户故事生成带优先级的功能测试用例，并输出 Excel 风格测试报告。
summaries.en: Generates prioritized functional test cases from PRDs, Git changes, or user stories and outputs an Excel-style test report.

capabilities: Analyzes PRDs, Git commit details, diffs, or user stories
Generates functional test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, state-transition, and data-consistency scenarios
Assigns test priorities such as P0, P1, and P2
Produces an Excel-style test report with overview, feature, and test-case sheets
